Then sum_v w_v[tau*(p_i)-c_v/2]_+<=I(Pi;Y)/2<=I_phys(f)/2 and sum_v w_v tau*(p_i)<=I_phys(f)/2+H(Pi|Y)/2. In the ordered family of uniform bounds A_T<=C I_phys(f)+lambda H(Pi|f), with finite fixed C and nonnegative lambda, the smallest coefficient over all product-biased Boolean functions and essential computing trees is lambda=1/2. The exact terminal-inclusive Fourier ledger is Hhat(f)=E Hhat(f_leaf)+2 sum_v w_v M_v+H(Pi|Y)/2+I(Pi;Y)/2-sum_v w_v[h2(p_i)/2-(J_v-M_v)]. Funding the output-conditional bank on a compatible spectral reference and paying the remaining erasure/terminal residual are not established.
